hypothesis: M170 improved the fixed objective but lost row 67, so stage2 PPO needs a more conservative recipe such as a shorter step budget or stronger anchoring before any continuation is admissible.
success_criteria: start only from the M168 admitted checkpoint, not from the failed M170 checkpoint
try a more conservative short stage2 recipe than M170
keep actor inputs unchanged and hidden labels out of the actor
run M169 fragile row guard with required row 67
run behavior retention and protected-key gates only if full replay and row67 guard pass
failure_criteria: accept a candidate that loses row 67
accept fixed objective improvement without replay retention
change actor inputs to make the stage pass

commands.name: m171_row67_preserving_stage2_recipe
commands.command: Run a conservative stage2 PPO variant from the M168 admitted checkpoint and gate it with fixed objective, full M164 replay, row67 guard, behavior retention, and protected key.

decision_rule: Reject any conservative stage2 recipe that loses row 67 or fails the full M164 replay gate, regardless of fixed objective improvement.
